mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video_capacity(owner_id) VALUES(#{owner}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE owner_id=owner_id
mapper.select: SELECT draft_count FROM video_capacity WHERE owner_id=0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE video_capacity SET draft_count=draft_count+1 WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND draft_count < #{limit}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM video_draft WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND request_id=#{request} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE video_draft SET state='QUEUED',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND state='UPLOADING' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM video_object_write WHERE video_id=#{id} AND kind='SOURCE' AND state='SETTLED')

UPDATE video_draft SET state='FAILED',failure_code='INTERRUPTED',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE (state='PROCESSING' AND lease_until <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) OR (state='UPLOADING' AND created_at < UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)-INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) LIMIT 50
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM video_draft WHERE state='PROCESSING' OR (processing_settled=FALSE AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
SELECT * FROM video_draft WHERE state='QUEUED' AND write_tracking=TRUE ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE video_draft SET state='PROCESSING',processing_settled=FALSE,run_id=#{run},lease_until=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)+INTERVAL 180 SECOND,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND state='QUEUED' AND write_tracking=TRUE
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM video_draft WHERE id=#{id} AND state='PROCESSING' AND run_id=#{run} AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)+INTERVAL 130 SECOND)
mapper.update: UPDATE video_draft SET state='READY',output_bytes=#{row.outputBytes},duration_millis=#{row.durationMillis},width=#{row.width},height=#{row.height},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{row.id} AND state='PROCESSING' AND run_id=#{row.runId} AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM video_object_write w WHERE w.video_id=#{row.id} AND w.kind='OUTPUT' AND w.run_id=#{row.runId} AND w.state='SETTLED')
UPDATE video_draft SET state='FAILED',failure_code=#{code},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND state='PROCESSING' AND run_id=#{run}
mapper.sql: v.*, CASE WHEN v.state<>'DELETING' THEN NULL WHEN v.write_tracking=FALSE THEN 'LEGACY_WRITES_UNVERIFIED' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM video_object_write w WHERE w.video_id=v.id AND w.state<>'SETTLED') THEN 'WRITES_UNVERIFIED' WHEN v.processing_settled=FALSE AND v.lease_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) THEN 'WAIT_PROCESSING' WHEN v.delete_attempts>=5 AND (v.delete_lease_until IS NULL OR v.delete_lease_until<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) THEN 'CLEANUP_FAILED' ELSE v.delete_error END AS deletion_wait_reason
mapper.select: SELECT FROM video_draft v WHERE v.active_owner_id=#{owner} ORDER BY v.created_at DESC,v.id DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT FROM video_draft v WHERE v.id=#{id} AND v.owner_id=#{owner}
SELECT * FROM video_draft WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE video_object_write SET state='SETTLED',settled_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND video_id=#{video} AND state='WRITING'
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM video_object_write WHERE id=#{id} AND video_id=#{video} AND state='SETTLED')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM video_draft WHERE id=#{id} AND write_tracking=TRUE AND state='PROCESSING' AND run_id=#{run} AND lease_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.update: UPDATE video_object_write SET state='UNCERTAIN' WHERE id=#{id} AND video_id=#{video} AND state='WRITING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM video_object_write WHERE video_id=#{id} AND state<>'SETTLED'
mapper.update: UPDATE video_draft SET processing_settled=TRUE WHERE id=#{id} AND run_id=#{run}

UPDATE video_draft SET state='DELETING',delete_request_id=#{request},delete_requested_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),delete_next_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND state NOT IN ('DELETING','DELETED')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM video_draft WHERE state='DELETING' AND delete_lease_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)

SELECT v.* FROM video_draft v WHERE v.state='DELETING' AND v.write_tracking=TRUE AND v.delete_attempts<5 AND v.delete_next_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (v.delete_lease_until IS NULL OR v.delete_lease_until<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND (v.processing_settled=TRUE OR v.lease_until IS NULL OR v.lease_until<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM video_object_write w WHERE w.video_id=v.id AND w.state<>'SETTLED') ORDER BY v.delete_next_at,v.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE video_draft SET delete_token=#{token},delete_lease_until=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)+INTERVAL 120 SECOND,delete_attempts=delete_attempts+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND state='DELETING' AND delete_attempts<5

UPDATE video_draft SET state='DELETED',deleted_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),delete_token=NULL,delete_lease_until=NULL,delete_next_at=NULL,delete_error=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND state='DELETING' AND delete_token=#{token} AND delete_lease_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE video_draft SET delete_token=NULL,delete_lease_until=NULL,delete_error='STORAGE_UNVERIFIED',delete_next_at=CASE WHEN delete_attempts<5 THEN TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,POW(2,delete_attempts),UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ELSE NULL END WHERE id=#{id} AND state='DELETING' AND delete_token=#{token} AND delete_lease_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
UPDATE video_capacity SET draft_count=draft_count-1 WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND draft_count>0
